title: Book Catalogue API
objective: Create a searchable catalogue of books and authors.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Book and author resources with relationships
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate book and author resources with relationships in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Category filtering and deterministic sorting
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate category filtering and deterministic sorting in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Bounded pagination and response schemas
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate bounded pagination and response schemas in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Endpoint map, API tests, and OpenAPI specification
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate endpoint map, api tests, and openapi specification in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

required_features: Book and author resources with relationships
Endpoint map, API tests, and OpenAPI specification
stretch_features: Add contract validation to CI and detect a breaking change.
Add structured request IDs and useful metrics without logging secrets.
Document a recovery or migration trade-off with alternatives.
tests: Test success, missing-resource, validation, and authorization outcomes.
Test duplicates and concurrent updates where the domain has non-idempotent side effects.
Run tests against a disposable database with deterministic fixtures.
Review public responses and logs for secret or personal-data exposure.
review_method: Automated tests and static contract checks plus human review against the rubric; no arbitrary learner code executes inside CodeLeaf’s production API.
status_note: Unreviewed project draft; validate scope, starter files, rubric and implementation assumptions before publication.
